_README: This is the ONE file that makes the Kiddush board yours. Fill in your details, keep the quote marks and commas exactly as they are, and save. Anything you leave empty is simply left off. After deploying you can still change prices, payment details and contact info from the staff page (Settings); this file gives the starting values.

location._help: timezone: a name like America/New_York, America/Chicago, America/Denver, America/Los_Angeles, Europe/London. zip: US zip code, used for candle lighting and Havdalah times on the TV. Outside the US leave zip empty and use geonameid (find your city at geonames.org). Candle lighting is 18 minutes before sunset; Havdalah 50 minutes after (change if your community's custom differs).

_publicUrl_help: publicUrl: the real address of this app if you gave it your own domain (leave empty to use the hosting address). shareUrl: the address to show on the TV and in its QR code, for example https://www.example.org/kiddush. Set it only once that address really opens the sponsor page (for example a page on your website that forwards to it).

prices._help: Dollars. 'board' is the price to sponsor the whole board for the year.

payments._help: Card payments need Stripe (see SETUP-GUIDE.md). For Zelle, Venmo, check and cash the sponsor is shown how to pay and you confirm it in the staff page. Leave an id/handle empty to hide that option.

board._help: Optional. Leave blessing/blessingHe out to use the traditional Mi Sheberach text.

reminders._help: Unpaid Zelle/Venmo/check/cash pledges: remind the sponsor by email after this many days (needs the optional email setup).
